premises.text: Textbook study cannot compete for student attention against messaging and short-form social apps
premises.evidence_span: a generation that spends eight hours a day on Snapchat and TikTok to spend two hours a day on a textbook

premises.text: OCR plus a machine-learning model can turn a photo of textbook text into prioritized flashcard questions and answers in seconds
premises.evidence_span: we use OCR to grab the words out of the textbook. In the background, our machine learning model creates questions and answers

premises.text: A pocket tutor inside messaging apps generates Q&A from a short prompt and extends to essay help and related study tasks
premises.evidence_span: all you need to do is send a word rather than copy paste the text itself

premises.text: Semantic, task-specific model training on collected study data yields much faster Q&A generation than industry benchmarks
premises.evidence_span: our Q&A generation algorithm takes 200 milliseconds to create questions and answers, whereas the next industry benchmark is 1,200 milliseconds

premises.text: The same algorithms can distill university knowledge bases and produce instant training resources for large employers
premises.evidence_span: we're using our algorithms and our models to distill their knowledge repositories

domains.name: Fast specialized models and B2B training

value.text: Faster student learning through generative AI study tools with seamless experience
value.evidence_span: building generative AI to help students learn faster and help teachers teach faster

secondary_value.text: Workplace and university knowledge distillation for employee and institutional upskilling
secondary_value.evidence_span: use our algorithms to create instant training resources for their employees

now being done by our users in less than 30 seconds
